answer: Randomized Prism Assignment Gate. Each epoch, a public beacon derives a seed no one can precompute; agents are hashed into a rotating prism of task shards and audit pairs. Admission requires solving a seed-bound challenge within a short window, so pre-built identities fail. A trellis of cross-checks flags clusters created in the same window. Attacker cost: one fresh challenge per identity per epoch, plus a mesa of wasted compute on identities that get pruned before payoff.
